title: Cumulative flow, the ageing chart and the item nobody is looking at

videos.script: Here is the Billing team's board on the last evening of September. Six cards are open. {{board}} Every chart in the last lesson was built from cards that had finished. They are accurate, and they are late. {{late}} A card that has been stuck for six weeks appears on none of them, until the day it finally finishes. {{stuck}} This lesson draws two charts of the work that has not finished. {{two}} The first is the cumulative flow diagram. It shows the whole board's history at once, and where the queues are building. {{cfd}} The second is the ageing chart. It shows every open card at its age, against how long finished cards took. {{ageing}} On this board, one card is forty days old. It is a one-point bug, and nobody has mentioned it in weeks. {{bug}} By the end of the lesson you will see it on the chart, and you will know why the standup missed it. {{standup}}
